summary: Seeded room-and-corridor dungeon map format. It emits multiple isolated wings in one bounded grid, with room markers, descent pads and lights for a game mode to populate.
useWhen: A grid shooter mode needs a larger repeatable room layout and will supply its own enemies, loot and floor-transition rules.
limitations: Shooter-family WorldDescription format only. Generates one map containing up to three isolated wings, not runtime map swaps.
It places inert room markers and descent pads; the game owns spawn composition, objectives, navigation presentation and transitions.
Layout is deterministic for a recipe seed; per-run encounter composition must be varied by the consuming game.
